recruiting_playbook_for_qualifying_teamm: Lab42 co-location: the building is already stacked with UvA AI students/researchers — daily proximity once you're a flex-desk regular

Offer a real UvA Informatics Institute Master's thesis project scoped to an actual initiative (interview-analysis tooling, AI-sonic-branding prototype) — the most institutionally legitimate recruiting channel
ICAI: the AI research center at Lab42/Science Park is industry-translation-oriented by mission; its researchers are DLAB-eligible by definition
Attend the open house directly and ask DLAB staff whether they informally matchmake outside founders with student technical cofounders
